entry.title: Write Less, Live More
entry.summary: I seem to read less and less of what's being written these days, whether on the Internet or in contemporary books. So much generalized (and, with or without AI, easily generated) analysis of what ails the modern world. So much breathless, pseudo-scientific advice about grit and atomic habits and the like. So much navel-gazing and self-promotion. So much writing for the sake of writing, not greatness in wisdom and life. Words, words, words....

entry.title: Destiny Calling
entry.summary: In previous journal entries, I've explored the lesser-known ideas of Spanish philosopher José Ortega y Gasset. Here I'd like to extend that series by looking at his insights into what we might call personal destiny, which can be found in his 1949 essay "In Search of Goethe from Within" (printed in the expanded 1968 edition of The Dehumanization of Art and Other Essays on Art, Culture, and Literature)....
